title: Register an inventory movement
description: The administrator can create an inventory entry and see the movement reflected in the inventory hub.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/inventario
Open the inventory entry form
Fill in a valid item quantity
Fill in a valid note for the movement
Save the inventory entry
Verify the inventory movement is recorded
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Download sales report CSV
description: The administrator can choose a date range and report type and download a sales CSV report.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/reporte-ventas
Choose a valid date range
Choose a report type
Download the report CSV
Verify a CSV download is initiated
Verify the selected report output is available

title: Run MRP planning and review replenishment results
description: An administrator can execute MRP planning and review the generated replenishment recommendations and history.
category: Sales CSV export; production batches; MRP planning; recipes/extras editor; menu editor; cash movement entry during shift.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the branch email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the branch password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Choose an active administrator employee
Fill in the PIN field with a valid PIN
Submit the PIN form
Open the MRP page
Run the planning calculation
Review the replenishment recommendations
Verify the MRP planning panel is shown
Verify replenishment results or history are displayed

title: Run a production batch from available ingredients
description: An administrator can start a production batch and see the resulting batch history in the production area.
category: Sales CSV export; production batches; MRP planning; recipes/extras editor; menu editor; cash movement entry during shift.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the branch email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the branch password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Choose an active administrator employee
Fill in the PIN field with a valid PIN
Submit the PIN form
Open the production page
Select a valid preparation
Enter a valid production quantity
Execute the production batch
Verify the production batch form is shown
Verify the recent production record appears

title: Run a production batch
description: The administrator can select a preparation, enter a quantity, and execute a production batch successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/produccion
Select a preparation for production
Fill in a valid production quantity
Run the production batch
Verify the production batch appears in recent history
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Plan production and validate replenishment decisions
description: An administrator can run a production batch and review MRP recommendations to support replenishment planning.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Select the administrator employee
Enter the employee PIN
Navigate to production batches
Select a preparation
Enter a production quantity
Confirm the production batch
Navigate to MRP planning
Review replenishment recommendations
Verify the new production batch appears in recent productions
Verify MRP planning results are displayed

title: Kardex shows who registered each entry
description: After registering an inventory entry, the Kardex modal lists it with the name of the employee who registered it.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and navigate to /admin/inventario
Open 'Registrar entrada de items', pick an insumo, quantity 3, cost total 30, and click 'Registrar Entrada'
Open the Kardex modal
Verify the new entry appears in the table
Verify the 'Registrado por' column shows the administrator's name for that entry

title: Export Kardex movements to CSV
description: The Kardex 'Exportar' button downloads a CSV with the listed movements.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and navigate to /admin/inventario
Register one inventory entry so the Kardex has data
Open the Kardex modal
Click 'Exportar'
Verify a file named kardex_YYYY-MM-DD.csv is downloaded
Verify the CSV header includes 'Registrado por'

title: Filter Kardex by date range
description: The 'Periodo' range date picker filters Kardex rows to the chosen dates.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator, register one inventory entry, and open the Kardex modal
In 'Periodo' pick a range that ends before today
Verify today's entry is no longer listed
Pick a range that includes today
Verify today's entry is listed again

title: Edit an inventory entry from the Kardex
description: An editable entry can be modified from the Kardex and the change is shown.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator, register one inventory entry with reference 'QA-EDIT'
Open the Kardex modal and click 'Editar' on that entry
Change the reference to 'QA-EDITADA' and save
Verify a success message is shown
Verify the Kardex lists the entry with the new reference

title: Void an inventory entry from the Kardex
description: An entry can be voided from the Kardex and stays visible as voided.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and register one inventory entry
Open the Kardex modal and click 'Anular' on that entry
Optionally type a reason and click 'Confirmar anulación'
Verify a success message 'Entrada anulada' is shown
Verify the entry shows the 'Anulada' badge

title: Inventory entry without lot code gets an automatic code
description: Leaving the optional 'Lote' field empty still saves the entry, with a generated lot code.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and navigate to /admin/inventario
Open 'Registrar entrada de items', pick an insumo, quantity 2, cost total 20, leave 'Lote' empty
Click 'Registrar Entrada'
Verify a success message is shown and no error appears
Open the Kardex modal
Verify the entry's lot code is not empty and looks like L-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX
Register a second entry for the same insumo, again with 'Lote' empty
Verify the second entry also saves successfully

title: Duplicate lot code shows a clear error
description: Registering an entry with a lot code already used for the same item shows a clear message instead of a server error.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and register an entry for an insumo with lot code 'QA-DUP-<timestamp>'
Register another entry for the same insumo with the same lot code
Verify an error message mentions that a lot with that code already exists
Verify the message is not 'Error interno del servidor'

title: Export the item catalog list to CSV
description: The 'Exportar Lista' button in 'Catálogo de Items' downloads a CSV of the listed items.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and navigate to /admin/inventario
Open the 'Catálogo de Items' modal
Click 'Exportar Lista'
Verify a file named items_YYYY-MM-DD.csv is downloaded
Verify the CSV includes the columns SKU, Nombre, Tipo, Unidad, Costo estándar and Estado

title: Deactivate and reactivate an item in the catalog
description: An item can be deactivated and reactivated from the catalog.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and open the 'Catálogo de Items' modal
Click 'Desactivar' on an item and accept the confirmation
Verify the item shows the 'Inactivo' label
Click 'Activar' on the same item and accept the confirmation
Verify the 'Inactivo' label is gone

title: Download the bulk item upload template
description: The bulk upload modal offers a CSV template download.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and navigate to /admin/inventario
Open the bulk upload (carga masiva) modal
Click the template download button
Verify a file named plantilla_items.csv is downloaded

title: Register a cash entry during the shift
description: A cashier with an open register can record a cash entry (ENTRADA) from 'Movimiento de caja'.

steps.description: Log in as the cashier and open the register on 'Apertura de Caja'
In the sales screen click 'Movimiento de caja'
Choose ENTRADA, amount 20, a short reason, and confirm
Verify a success confirmation is shown
Verify the movement appears in the register's movements or summary

title: Register a cash withdrawal during the shift
description: A cashier with an open register can record a cash withdrawal (SALIDA).

steps.description: Log in as the cashier and open the register with a counted total of at least 50
Click 'Movimiento de caja'
Choose SALIDA, amount 10, a short reason, and confirm
Verify a success confirmation is shown
Verify the movement is reflected in the register summary

title: Browse recipes and preparations
description: The recipes page lists technical sheets for sellable products and base preparations.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and navigate to /admin/recetas
Verify 'Total Fichas Técnicas', 'Productos Vendibles' and 'Preparaciones Base' counters are shown
Verify the 'Hamburguesa Smoke' recipe is listed
Sort by 'Nombre (Z → A)'
Verify the list order changes

title: Browse and search the product menu
description: The menu page lists products and the search filters them.

steps.description: Log in as the administrator and navigate to /admin/menu
Verify 'Menú de productos' lists 'Hamburguesa Smoke'
Search for a name that does not exist
Verify 'Ningún producto coincide' is shown

title: Wrong branch password shows an error
description: Signing in with a wrong branch password shows an error and stays on the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Enter the branch email with the wrong password 'Incorrecta123!' and click 'Iniciar Sesión'
Verify an error message is shown
Verify the employee selection page is not shown

title: Wrong PIN shows an error
description: Entering a wrong PIN shows an error and does not enter the employee area.

steps.description: Log in with the branch email and password
At /usuarios click the cashier card
Enter PIN 9999 and click 'Ingresar'
Verify an error message is shown
Verify the cashier area is not shown

title: Cashier cannot open the admin area
description: A cashier who navigates to /admin is sent back to the cashier area.

steps.description: Log in as the cashier (branch login, cashier card, PIN 1234)
Navigate directly to /admin
Verify the administrator dashboard is not shown
Verify the app redirects to the cashier area

title: Unauthenticated user is redirected from admin
description: Opening /admin without signing in redirects to the branch login.

steps.description: In a fresh session with no cookies, navigate to /admin
Verify the branch login form with 'Iniciar Sesión' is shown

title: Signup with a duplicate admin username shows a clear error
description: Creating the first administrator with a username that already exists shows a clear message, not a server error.

steps.description: Navigate to /signup and register a new branch with a unique email
On the first-administrator form use the username of your test's admin employee (already taken)
Submit the form
Verify an error message says the username or email already exists
Verify the message is not 'Error interno del servidor'

title: Filter admin sales by date range
description: The 'Periodo' range picker in sales audit filters the listed sales.

steps.description: Log in as the cashier, open the register, sell one 'Hamburguesa Smoke' and pay in cash
Log in as the administrator and navigate to /admin/ventas
In 'Periodo' pick a range that ends before today
Verify today's sale is not listed
Pick a range including today
Verify today's sale is listed
